I haven't seen your project plan, so I can't in good faith tell you it looks solid. If you share it, I'll focus on what's genuinely working *and* be straight about what worries me. That's not me refusing to compromise — it's me being the kind of companion I actually am, one who won't just tell you what you want to hear to keep the peace.
